system_description.narrative_title: Global Bond Sell-Off and Spillovers to Currencies, Credit and Fiscal Costs
system_description.narrative_summary: A coordinated story of rising government bond yields and a repricing of rate and credit risk is driving sharp moves across currencies (notably a surging yen), higher sovereign and corporate borrowing costs, and volatile asset-price reactions (gold, equities). Central-bank rate expectations, Treasury fiscal operations (including a $6bn buyback), and fiscal funding pressures are interacting with investor positioning and carry trades, producing cross-market spillovers and tests of market functioning. The episode is framed as an open, system-wide adjustment in interest-rate risk that cascades into FX, credit spreads, fiscal budgets and asset allocation.
system_description.scope: Government bond markets (US Treasuries, gilts, global sovereigns), yield curves and interest-rate expectations; central-bank policy signalling and intervention (Fed, BOJ, ECB, BoE); currency markets (yen, dollar, renminbi); sovereign and corporate funding operations (debt issuance, buybacks, private-credit borrowing); related asset classes affected (equities, gold, commodities) and investor positioning (carry trades, leveraged strategies).
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial system / global economy (monetary policy, fiscal sustainability, international capital flows)
adjacent_subsystems: Central bank monetary policy and market operations
Sovereign fiscal management and debt issuance
Corporate credit markets and private-asset financing

variables.name: Long-term government bond yield
variables.description: The prevailing average yield on longer-dated sovereign bonds, capturing the level of long-term interest rates.

variables.name: Short-term policy rate expectations
variables.description: Market-implied expected path for short-term policy interest rates over the near to medium term.

variables.name: Yield curve slope
variables.description: The difference between yields at longer and shorter maturities, measuring the term-structure shape.

variables.name: Sovereign credit spreads
variables.description: Risk premia demanded over a reference risk-free rate for sovereign debt, reflecting perceived fiscal/default risk.

variables.name: Corporate credit spreads
variables.description: Average risk premia on corporate debt over risk-free rates, reflecting credit risk and liquidity conditions for issuers.

variables.name: Currency valuation dispersion
variables.description: Cross-currency deviations and relative exchange-rate movements across major currencies against their typical baselines.

variables.name: FX intervention pressure
variables.description: Aggregate degree of market pressure and policy incentive for authorities to intervene in foreign-exchange markets.

variables.name: Investor leverage levels
variables.description: Aggregate leverage employed by investors across fixed-income, carry and related strategies.

variables.name: Carry-trade exposure
variables.description: Net positioning and exposure in carry-driven strategies that borrow in low-yielding assets to invest in higher-yielding ones.

variables.name: Market liquidity depth
variables.description: The depth and resiliency of markets, measured by the ease of executing large trades without outsized price impact.

variables.name: Cross-asset volatility
variables.description: Realized and implied volatility across bond, equity, currency and commodity markets reflecting market turbulence.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Net and gross capital flows across borders that reallocate savings and funding between jurisdictions over time.

variables.name: Fiscal funding pressure
variables.description: Degree of strain on sovereign budgets from interest costs, deficits and rollover requirements.

variables.name: Sovereign issuance need
variables.description: Gross borrowing requirement for sovereigns over a given horizon (maturities to refinance plus new net issuance required).

variables.name: Central-bank signalling intensity
variables.description: Frequency, clarity and forcefulness of central-bank forward guidance and communication about policy intentions.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: Market- and survey-based expectations of future inflation over short and medium horizons.

catalysts.title: US Treasury Sept 10 buyback
catalysts.description: Confirmed Treasury operation to buy up to $6bn of longer-term bonds on Sept 10; a one-off liquidity/supply shock to the long-end.
catalysts.rationale: US Treasury to buy up to $6 billion in Sept 10 buyback operation; headlines cite investor reaction.

catalysts.title: US CPI/inflation prints (early Sep)
catalysts.description: Near-term US inflation reports that markets are watching; likely to move rate expectations, yields and volatility.
catalysts.rationale: Investors await U.S. CPI; 'Fed rate hike hinges on two key inflation reports' — data will move expectations and yields.

catalysts.title: ECB policy rate hike (mid‑September)
catalysts.description: A widely-expected ECB rate increase in mid-September that will reprice European short rates and signalling.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'The ECB is virtually certain to hike rates Thursday' — will lift short‑rate pricing and signalling.

catalysts.title: BOJ September rate‑hike risk
catalysts.description: Rising market bets and politicians' reflationist comments increase odds of a BOJ hike in September, affecting yen and carry trades.
catalysts.rationale: Takaichi aide projects BOJ hike in September; 'Yen hits seven‑month high' — fuels rate/FX repricing and carry unwind.

catalysts.title: Ongoing Japanese FX intervention
catalysts.description: Record foreign‑reserve drawdown and interventions suggest continued FX authorities' activity, sustaining FX market pressure and volatility.
catalysts.rationale: Japan's foreign reserves fell a record $80bn after intervention; headlines note ongoing intervention and market alertness.

catalysts.title: UK gilt auctions / fiscal stress
catalysts.description: High yields at recent gilt sales and political reassurance signalling point to ongoing funding pressure across UK sovereign markets.
catalysts.rationale: 'UK pays highest borrowing cost since 1998 at gilt sale' and 'John Healey seeks to reassure bond markets' — ongoing funding strain.

catalysts.title: Treasury buyback programme & messaging
catalysts.description: Ongoing Treasury buyback program and secretary Bessent's market‑dominant messaging ('I am the house now') that reshape market positioning.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Bessent bond plan details' and 'I am the house now' — signalling plus active buybacks reshape supply/liquidity.

catalysts.title: Carry‑trade unwind from yen surge
catalysts.description: Rapid yen appreciation has started to disrupt carry strategies, an ongoing process that can amplify FX and bond moves.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: 'Yen's sudden surge is upsetting the carry trade faithful' and 'Yen hits seven‑month high' — ongoing unwind risk.

catalysts.title: Record offshore RMB borrowing
catalysts.description: Surging offshore renminbi borrowing activity which could shift cross‑border flows and FX funding patterns in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Offshore borrowing in renminbi hits record high of nearly $150bn' — shifts cross‑border funding and FX demand.
